output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # separator rows/cols are uniform, with separator color distinct from dominant background
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    # background is most frequent value among non-uniform cells / overall, excluding line color
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r)
    line=set(grid[i][0] for i in rows) | set(grid[0][j] for j in cols)
    bg=max((x for x in cnt if x not in line), key=lambda x:cnt[x], default=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0])
    return [[bg]*(len(cols)+1) for _ in range(len(rows)+1)]"}
